::: {style="max-width: 68ch;"}
The Risk Theory Society meets once a year. Ten papers are selected, each is
discussed for a full hour, and everyone in the room has read everything. This
page tracks what became of those papers — which reached print, where, and how
long it took.

The record here covers
[31 meetings between 1984 and 2024]{#rts-intro-coverage}, along with the meeting
history itself: who presided, who hosted, and how the society grew.

**A blank journal means we have no publication recorded, not that a paper was
never published.** Tracking is more complete for some years than others, and
recent cohorts are still working through review — the median paper takes
[three years]{#rts-intro-lag} from the meeting to print. Read the last few
years accordingly.
:::

```{=html}
      <li id="rts-note-lag"></li>

        titles are one lineage renamed twice — <em>Geneva Papers on Risk and

        Insurance Review</em> — and are counted separately here. <em>Geneva
        Papers on Risk and Insurance&mdash;Issues and Practice</em> is a
        different journal.</li>

  "use strict";

  var GARNET = "#782F40";
  var GOLD = "#CEB888";
  var BLANK = "#e0dcd4";
  var SVGNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  // A paper is treated as still working through review if its meeting is within
  // MATURITY years of the most recent one tracked. Placement rates are quoted
  // only over the cohorts past that line, so the recent years — which look bad
  // purely because of publication lag — do not drag the headline number down.
  var MATURITY = 5;

  var raw = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("rts-data").textContent);

  var papers = raw.papers.map(function (row) {
    return {
      year: row[0],
      title: row[1],
      authors: row[2].map(function (a) { return { name: a[0], affil: a[1] }; }),
      journal: row[3] || "",
      published: row[4],
      link: row[5] || ""
    };
  });

  var meetings = raw.meetings.map(function (row) {
    return {
      year: row[0], president: row[1], presidentAffil: row[2], host: row[3],
      location: row[4], date: row[5], paperCount: row[6],
      members: row[7], attendees: row[8]
    };
  });

  if (!papers.length) { return; }

  // ---- Derived quantities ------------------------------------------------

  var paperYears = papers.map(function (p) { return p.year; })
    .filter(function (y, i, a) { return a.indexOf(y) === i; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });

  var latestYear = paperYears[paperYears.length - 1];
  var matureCutoff = latestYear - MATURITY;
  var mature = papers.filter(function (p) { return p.year <= matureCutoff; });
  var maturePlaced = mature.filter(function (p) { return p.journal; });
  var placementRate = Math.round(100 * maturePlaced.length / mature.length);

  var lags = papers
    .filter(function (p) { return p.published != null; })
    .map(function (p) { return p.published - p.year; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
  var medianLag = lags.length
    ? (lags.length % 2
        ? lags[(lags.length - 1) / 2]
        : (lags[lags.length / 2 - 1] + lags[lags.length / 2]) / 2)
    : null;

  var journalCounts = {};
  papers.forEach(function (p) {
    if (p.journal) { journalCounts[p.journal] = (journalCounts[p.journal] || 0) + 1; }
  });
  var journals = Object.keys(journalCounts).map(function (name) {
    return { name: name, count: journalCounts[name] };
  }).sort(function (a, b) {
    return b.count - a.count || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  });

  var people = {};
  papers.forEach(function (p) {
    p.authors.forEach(function (a) { people[a.name] = true; });
  });
  var authorCount = Object.keys(people).length;

  // ---- Small helpers -----------------------------------------------------

  function svgEl(name, attrs, text) {
    var node = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, name);
    for (var key in attrs) {
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(attrs, key)) {
        node.setAttribute(key, attrs[key]);
      }
    }
    if (text != null) { node.textContent = text; }
    return node;
  }

  function svgRoot(mount, width, height) {
    mount.textContent = "";
    var svg = svgEl("svg", {
      viewBox: "0 0 " + width + " " + height,
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid meet",
      role: "img"
    });
    mount.appendChild(svg);
    return svg;
  }

  function escapeHtml(value) {
    return String(value)
      .replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
      .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
  }

  function plural(n, one, many) { return n === 1 ? one : (many || one + "s"); }

  // House style: spell out one through nine in prose, numerals from 10 up.
  // The headline tiles are exempt — those are figures, not sentences.
  var WORDS = ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven",
    "eight", "nine"];
  function spell(n) {
    return (Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 0 && n < 10) ? WORDS[n] : String(n);
  }

  function joinList(items) {
    if (items.length <= 1) { return items.join(""); }
    if (items.length === 2) { return items[0] + " and " + items[1]; }
    return items.slice(0, -1).join(", ") + ", and " + items[items.length - 1];
  }

  // ---- Intro prose -------------------------------------------------------

  // The two figures quoted in the standing intro are filled from the data
  // rather than written into the page. The workbook is the source of truth and
  // gains a meeting a year; prose that hardcodes the range goes stale on the
  // first refresh, and stale framing above a live table is worse than none.
  // Stating the span and letting the notes enumerate the gaps beats stitching
  // the present years into runs. The workbook records a president for 2020 but
  // no host, dates, or papers — the same shape as 1991 and 1992, which were
  // held but went undocumented. Nothing in the data separates "no meeting" from
  // "meeting, no record", so the prose does not guess.
  function renderIntro() {
    var intro = document.getElementById("rts-intro-coverage");
    if (intro) {
      intro.textContent = paperYears.length + " meetings between " +
        paperYears[0] + " and " + latestYear;
    }

    var lag = document.getElementById("rts-intro-lag");
    if (lag && medianLag != null) {
      lag.textContent = spell(medianLag) + " " + plural(medianLag, "year");
    }
  }

  // ---- Headline figures --------------------------------------------------

  function renderTiles() {
    var tiles = [
      [paperYears.length, "meetings with a program recorded, " +
        paperYears[0] + "&ndash;" + latestYear],
      [papers.length, "papers presented, by " + authorCount + " authors"],
      [placementRate + "%", "of papers through " + matureCutoff +
        " reached print"],
      [medianLag + " " + plural(medianLag, "year"),
        "median time from the meeting to publication"]
    ];
    document.getElementById("rts-tiles").innerHTML = tiles.map(function (t) {
      return '<div class="rts-tile"><div class="rts-tile__value">' + t[0] +
        '</div><div class="rts-tile__label">' + t[1] + "</div></div>";
    }).join("");
  }

  // ---- Chart: papers per year, split by outcome --------------------------

  function renderYearChart() {
    // Drawn over the continuous run only. Isolated early years are reported in
    // the notes instead of stretching the axis across a decade-wide gap.
    var runStart = latestYear;
    for (var i = paperYears.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      if (paperYears[i] - paperYears[i - 1] > 3) { break; }
      runStart = paperYears[i - 1];
    }

    var years = [];
    for (var y = runStart; y <= latestYear; y++) { years.push(y); }

    var stats = years.map(function (year) {
      var group = papers.filter(function (p) { return p.year === year; });
      return {
        year: year,
        total: group.length,
        placed: group.filter(function (p) { return p.journal; }).length
      };
    });

    var W = 820, H = 270, L = 30, R = 8, T = 14, B = 34;
    var max = Math.max.apply(null, stats.map(function (s) { return s.total; }));
    max = Math.ceil(max / 2) * 2;
    var plotW = W - L - R, plotH = H - T - B;
    var step = plotW / years.length;
    var barW = Math.min(step - 4, 26);

    var svg = svgRoot(document.getElementById("rts-chart-years"), W, H);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("title", {}, "Papers presented at each meeting, " +
      runStart + " to " + latestYear + ", split by whether a publication is recorded"));

    var yScale = function (v) { return T + plotH - (v / max) * plotH; };

    // Censoring band behind the bars.
    var bandStart = matureCutoff + 1;
    if (bandStart <= latestYear) {
      var bandX = L + years.indexOf(bandStart) * step;
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("rect", {
        x: bandX, y: T, width: L + plotW - bandX, height: plotH,
        fill: "rgba(206,184,136,0.35)"
      }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
        x: bandX + 5, y: T + 12, class: "rts-axis", "font-style": "italic"
      }, "still in review"));
    }

    for (var g = 0; g <= max; g += 2) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", {
        x1: L, x2: W - R, y1: yScale(g), y2: yScale(g), class: "rts-gridline"
      }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
        x: L - 6, y: yScale(g) + 3, class: "rts-axis", "text-anchor": "end"
      }, g));
    }

    stats.forEach(function (s, index) {
      var x = L + index * step + (step - barW) / 2;
      if (s.total === 0) {
        svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
          x: x + barW / 2, y: yScale(0) - 4, class: "rts-axis",
          "text-anchor": "middle"
        }, "—"));
      } else {
        var unplaced = s.total - s.placed;
        if (unplaced > 0) {
          svg.appendChild(svgEl("rect", {
            x: x, y: yScale(s.total), width: barW,
            height: yScale(s.placed) - yScale(s.total), fill: BLANK
          }));
        }
        if (s.placed > 0) {
          svg.appendChild(svgEl("rect", {
            x: x, y: yScale(s.placed), width: barW,
            height: yScale(0) - yScale(s.placed), fill: GARNET
          }));
        }
        var label = svgEl("title", {}, s.year + ": " + s.total + " " +
          plural(s.total, "paper") + ", " + s.placed + " with a publication recorded");
        svg.appendChild(label);
      }

      if (s.year % 5 === 0 || index === 0 || index === stats.length - 1) {
        svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
          x: x + barW / 2, y: H - B + 16, class: "rts-axis",
          "text-anchor": "middle"
        }, s.year));
      }
    });

    svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", {
      x1: L, x2: W - R, y1: yScale(0), y2: yScale(0),
      stroke: "#999", "stroke-width": 1
    }));

    document.getElementById("rts-year-sub").innerHTML =
      "Each meeting selects about ten papers. The garnet portion is the share " +
      "with a publication recorded; through " + matureCutoff + " that is " +
      placementRate + "% of all papers presented. The shaded years are too " +
      "recent to judge &mdash; at a median lag of " + spell(medianLag) + " " +
      plural(medianLag, "year") + ", most of those papers are still in review.";
  }

  // ---- Chart: journals ---------------------------------------------------

  function renderJournalChart() {
    var top = journals.slice(0, 14);
    var rowH = 22, W = 820, L = 300, R = 40, T = 6;
    var H = T + top.length * rowH + 6;
    var max = top[0].count;
    var plotW = W - L - R;

    var svg = svgRoot(document.getElementById("rts-chart-journals"), W, H);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("title", {}, "Journals publishing the most Risk Theory Society papers"));

    top.forEach(function (journal, index) {
      var y = T + index * rowH;
      var width = Math.max(2, (journal.count / max) * plotW);
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
        x: L - 8, y: y + rowH / 2 + 4, class: "rts-axis",
        "text-anchor": "end", "font-size": "11"
      }, journal.name));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("rect", {
        x: L, y: y + 3, width: width, height: rowH - 8, fill: GARNET,
        rx: 2, opacity: index === 0 ? 1 : 0.82
      }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
        x: L + width + 6, y: y + rowH / 2 + 4, class: "rts-axis",
        "font-size": "11"
      }, journal.count));
    });

    var placed = papers.filter(function (p) { return p.journal; }).length;
    document.getElementById("rts-journal-sub").innerHTML =
      "The " + placed + " papers with a publication recorded are spread across " +
      journals.length + " journals. The <em>Journal of Risk and Insurance</em> " +
      "takes the largest single share, but most placements are outside it.";
  }

  // ---- Chart: members and attendees --------------------------------------

  function renderGrowthChart() {
    var series = meetings.filter(function (m) {
      return m.members != null || m.attendees != null;
    });
    if (series.length < 2) { return; }

    var W = 820, H = 240, L = 30, R = 40, T = 14, B = 30;
    var plotW = W - L - R, plotH = H - T - B;
    var minYear = series[0].year, maxYear = series[series.length - 1].year;
    var values = [];
    series.forEach(function (m) {
      if (m.members != null) { values.push(m.members); }
      if (m.attendees != null) { values.push(m.attendees); }
    });
    var max = Math.ceil(Math.max.apply(null, values) / 20) * 20;

    var xScale = function (year) {
      return L + ((year - minYear) / (maxYear - minYear)) * plotW;
    };
    var yScale = function (value) { return T + plotH - (value / max) * plotH; };

    var svg = svgRoot(document.getElementById("rts-chart-growth"), W, H);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("title", {},
      "Risk Theory Society membership and meeting attendance, " +
      minYear + " to " + maxYear));

    for (var g = 0; g <= max; g += 20) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("line", {
        x1: L, x2: W - R, y1: yScale(g), y2: yScale(g), class: "rts-gridline"
      }));
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
        x: L - 6, y: yScale(g) + 3, class: "rts-axis", "text-anchor": "end"
      }, g));
    }

    [["members", GARNET], ["attendees", GOLD]].forEach(function (spec) {
      var key = spec[0], color = spec[1];
      var points = series.filter(function (m) { return m[key] != null; });
      // Breaks in the record are drawn as breaks in the line rather than
      // interpolated across, so a missing year never reads as a real trend.
      var runs = [], current = [];
      points.forEach(function (m, index) {
        if (index > 0 && m.year - points[index - 1].year > 3) {
          runs.push(current); current = [];
        }
        current.push(m);
      });
      runs.push(current);

      runs.forEach(function (run) {
        if (run.length > 1) {
          svg.appendChild(svgEl("polyline", {
            points: run.map(function (m) {
              return xScale(m.year) + "," + yScale(m[key]);
            }).join(" "),
            fill: "none", stroke: color, "stroke-width": 2,
            "stroke-linejoin": "round"
          }));
        }
      });

      points.forEach(function (m) {
        var dot = svgEl("circle", {
          cx: xScale(m.year), cy: yScale(m[key]), r: 2.6, fill: color
        });
        dot.appendChild(svgEl("title", {}, m.year + ": " + m[key] + " " + key));
        svg.appendChild(dot);
      });

      var last = points[points.length - 1];
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
        x: xScale(last.year) + 7, y: yScale(last[key]) + 4,
        class: "rts-axis", "font-size": "11", fill: color,
        "font-weight": "700"
      }, last[key]));
    });

    for (var year = Math.ceil(minYear / 5) * 5; year <= maxYear; year += 5) {
      svg.appendChild(svgEl("text", {
        x: xScale(year), y: H - B + 16, class: "rts-axis",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      }, year));
    }

    var first = series[0], recent = series[series.length - 1];
    document.getElementById("rts-growth-sub").innerHTML =
      "Membership ran " + first.members + " in " + first.year + " and " +
      recent.members + " in " + recent.year + ". Attendance has tracked " +
      "roughly half to two-thirds of the roll.";
  }

  // ---- Papers table ------------------------------------------------------

  var sortKey = "year", sortDir = -1;
  var searchBox = document.getElementById("rts-search");
  var yearFilter = document.getElementById("rts-year-filter");
  var placedOnly = document.getElementById("rts-placed-only");
  var tbody = document.querySelector("#rts-papers tbody");

  papers.forEach(function (p) {
    p.haystack = [
      p.title,
      p.journal,
      p.authors.map(function (a) { return a.name + " " + a.affil; }).join(" ")
    ].join(" ").toLowerCase();
  });

  function authorsHtml(paper) {
    return paper.authors.map(function (a) {
      var name = '<span class="rts-authors">' + escapeHtml(a.name) + "</span>";
      return a.affil
        ? name + ' <span class="rts-affil">(' + escapeHtml(a.affil) + ")</span>"
        : name;
    }).join("<br>");
  }

  function outcomeHtml(paper) {
    if (!paper.journal && paper.published == null) {
      return '<span class="rts-none" title="No publication recorded. This does ' +
        'not mean the paper was never published.">Not recorded</span>';
    }
    var html = '<span class="rts-journal">' + escapeHtml(paper.journal) + "</span>";
    if (paper.published != null) {
      // A handful of papers carry a publication year at or before the meeting
      // year — an accepted paper presented on its way to print. "0 yrs after"
      // and "-1 yrs after" are not sentences, so those cases get their own.
      var lag = paper.published - paper.year;
      var gap = lag > 0
        ? lag + " " + plural(lag, "yr") + " after"
        : (lag === 0 ? "same year" : -lag + " " + plural(-lag, "yr") + " earlier");
      html += '<br><span class="rts-pubyear">' + paper.published +
        " &middot; " + gap + "</span>";
    }
    return html;
  }

  function render() {
    var query = searchBox.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    var year = yearFilter.value;
    var rows = papers.filter(function (p) {
      if (year !== "all" && p.year !== Number(year)) { return false; }
      if (placedOnly.checked && !p.journal) { return false; }
      return !query || p.haystack.indexOf(query) !== -1;
    });

    rows.sort(function (a, b) {
      var result;
      if (sortKey === "year") {
        result = a.year - b.year || a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
      } else if (sortKey === "journal") {
        // Unrecorded outcomes sort last in either direction; they carry no
        // ordering information and should not fill the top of the table.
        if (!a.journal && !b.journal) { return a.year - b.year; }
        if (!a.journal) { return 1; }
        if (!b.journal) { return -1; }
        result = a.journal.localeCompare(b.journal) || a.year - b.year;
      } else {
        result = a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
      }
      return result * sortDir;
    });

    tbody.innerHTML = rows.map(function (p) {
      var title = p.link
        ? '<a href="' + escapeHtml(p.link) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' +
          escapeHtml(p.title) + "</a>"
        : escapeHtml(p.title);
      return "<tr>" +
        '<td class="rts-year">' + p.year + "</td>" +
        '<td class="rts-title">' + title + "</td>" +
        "<td>" + authorsHtml(p) + "</td>" +
        "<td>" + outcomeHtml(p) + "</td>" +
        "</tr>";
    }).join("");

    if (!rows.length) {
      tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="rts-empty">' +
        "No papers match that search.</td></tr>";
    }

    document.getElementById("rts-count").textContent =
      "Showing " + rows.length + " of " + papers.length + " papers";
  }

  function setupTable() {
    yearFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="all">All meetings</option>' +
      paperYears.slice().reverse().map(function (y) {
        return '<option value="' + y + '">' + y + "</option>";
      }).join("");

    searchBox.addEventListener("input", render);
    yearFilter.addEventListener("change", render);
    placedOnly.addEventListener("change", render);

    var headers = document.querySelectorAll("#rts-papers th.rts-sortable");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(headers, function (th) {
      th.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
      function activate() {
        var key = th.getAttribute("data-key");
        if (key === sortKey) {
          sortDir = -sortDir;
        } else {
          sortKey = key;
          sortDir = key === "year" ? -1 : 1;
        }
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(headers, function (other) {
          other.classList.remove("rts-sorted-asc", "rts-sorted-desc");
        });
        th.classList.add(sortDir === 1 ? "rts-sorted-asc" : "rts-sorted-desc");
        render();
      }
      th.addEventListener("click", activate);
      th.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
          event.preventDefault();
          activate();
        }
      });
    });

    document.querySelector('#rts-papers th[data-key="year"]')
      .classList.add("rts-sorted-desc");
    render();
  }

  // ---- Meetings table ----------------------------------------------------

  function renderMeetings() {
    var body = document.querySelector("#rts-meetings tbody");

    // A meeting is upcoming if it falls after the last one the society has
    // recorded any counts for. Keying off the last year with papers instead
    // would label a meeting that has already happened as upcoming whenever its
    // program has yet to be entered, which is exactly the state the workbook
    // is usually in.
    var held = meetings.filter(function (m) {
      return m.paperCount != null || m.members != null || m.attendees != null;
    });
    var upcoming = (held.length ? held[held.length - 1].year : latestYear) + 1;

    body.innerHTML = meetings.slice().reverse().map(function (m) {
      function cell(value, extra) {
        return value
          ? "<td" + (extra || "") + ">" + escapeHtml(value) + "</td>"
          : "<td" + (extra || "") + '><span class="rts-none">&mdash;</span></td>';
      }
      function number(value) {
        return value == null
          ? '<td style="text-align:right"><span class="rts-none">&mdash;</span></td>'
          : '<td style="text-align:right">' + value + "</td>";
      }
      var president = m.president
        ? escapeHtml(m.president) + (m.presidentAffil
            ? '<br><span class="rts-affil">' + escapeHtml(m.presidentAffil) + "</span>"
            : "")
        : '<span class="rts-none">&mdash;</span>';
      var tag = m.year >= upcoming ? '<span class="rts-tag">Upcoming</span>' : "";

      return '<tr class="' + (m.year >= upcoming ? "rts-upcoming" : "") + '">' +
        '<td class="rts-year">' + m.year + tag + "</td>" +
        "<td>" + president + "</td>" +
        cell(m.host) + cell(m.location) + cell(m.date) +
        number(m.paperCount) + number(m.members) + number(m.attendees) +
        "</tr>";
    }).join("");

    var text = "Presidents and hosts from " + meetings[0].year + " through " +
      meetings[meetings.length - 1].year + ".";

    var noHost = meetings.filter(function (m) {
      return m.year < upcoming && m.president && !m.host;
    }).map(function (m) { return m.year; });
    if (noHost.length) {
      text += " No host or location is recorded for " +
        joinList(noHost.map(String)) + ".";
    }

    var ahead = meetings.filter(function (m) { return m.year >= upcoming && m.host; });
    if (ahead.length) {
      text += " Coming up: " + ahead.map(function (m) {
        return escapeHtml(m.host) + " (" + m.year + ")";
      }).join(", then ") + ".";
    }
    document.getElementById("rts-meetings-sub").innerHTML = text;
  }

  // ---- Notes -------------------------------------------------------------

  function renderNotes() {
    var gaps = [];
    for (var y = paperYears[0]; y < latestYear; y++) {
      if (paperYears.indexOf(y) === -1) { gaps.push(y); }
    }
    var spans = [];
    gaps.forEach(function (year) {
      var last = spans[spans.length - 1];
      if (last && year === last[1] + 1) { last[1] = year; } else { spans.push([year, year]); }
    });
    var gapText = joinList(spans.map(function (s) {
      return s[0] === s[1] ? String(s[0]) : s[0] + "&ndash;" + s[1];
    }));

    document.getElementById("rts-note-coverage").innerHTML =
      "Programs are recorded for " + paperYears.length + " meetings between " +
      paperYears[0] + " and " + latestYear + "." +
      (gapText ? " No papers are recorded for " + gapText + "." : "");

    var counts = {};
    lags.forEach(function (l) { counts[l] = (counts[l] || 0) + 1; });
    var quick = lags.filter(function (l) { return l <= 2; }).length;
    document.getElementById("rts-note-lag").innerHTML =
      "Of the " + lags.length + " papers with a publication year, " + quick +
      " appeared within two years of the meeting and the slowest took " +
      lags[lags.length - 1] + " years. The median is " + spell(medianLag) +
      " " + plural(medianLag, "year") + ".";

    var noCounts = meetings.filter(function (m) { return m.members == null; });
    document.getElementById("rts-note-meetings").innerHTML =
      "Member and attendee counts come from the society's own records and are " +
      "missing for " + noCounts.length + " of the " + meetings.length +
      " meetings listed.";
  }

  renderIntro();
  renderTiles();
  renderYearChart();
  renderJournalChart();
  renderGrowthChart();
  setupTable();
  renderMeetings();
  renderNotes();
})();
</script>
```
